lines.en: This is not supposed to happen...
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: How about that.  All four Nephilim, trapped... wherever this is, all by our lonesome.
lines.zh: 真是奇了。 四个圣灵都被困在了……不知什么地方，孤孤零零的四个人。
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Don't despair yet...  There are several entry points in this tower.  It is possible that the others are scattered in the area.  Can't say for sure, darlings...
lines.zh: 先别绝望…… 这座塔有好几个入口。 有可能其他人只是被分散在了这个地区。 不过我不敢保证，亲爱的们……
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: Seems we have no choice.  Let's get on with it.
lines.zh: 看来我们别无选择。 继续前进吧。
